records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 18.4 percent in the third quarter of 2022 compared to the same period in 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the third quarter of 2022, LTL shipments were down 2.5 percent per workday and LTL tonnage was down 0.4 percent per workday compared to the prior year quarter.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 82.4 percent in the third quarter of 2022 compared to 82.8 percent in the third quarter of 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The improved operating ratio compared to prior year is due to the Company’s continued focus on pricing initiatives, cost control and operating efficiencies in addition to the impact of our fuel surcharge program.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $128.4 million for the third quarter of 2022 compared to $106.1 million for the third quarter of 2021.
